Hello! My name is Godrekton, I'm a Renekton player of 12 years starting from season 3, amassing 1000's upon 1000's of games, playing with up towards 7 million mastery points on Renekton. Throughout my time of playing Renekton, I have simply played many games throughout high elo, including all the apex ranks of Masters, Grandmaster and Challenger level games, which achieveing Rank 1 Renekton on various sites through my time of playing. Today my ambitions and desires are set towards making consistent content trying to educate and entertain the top lane and Renekton mains community, while trying to also reach Challenger and see how far I can actually go. Whilst I have been on my ranked and Renekton journey, I’ve also took the time to massively educate myself on watching many other great and amazing Renekton players through the years, ultimately making me use a lot of my spare time to try and learn all the smart, crazy and fun strategies that come around with one tricking Renekton.

As someone that truly loves Renekton as a champion, as well as the amazing community that is of Renekton mains, I’ve simply decided to take my last couple of years of trying to create the most detailed and ultimate guide that anyone could simply create on a champion. Originally, this was supposed to be a simple match up spreadsheet, which people such as FoggedBTW and RTO completely inspired me into making, which led me to creating within the last couple of years. However last year I actually lost my original spreadsheet copy for Renekton match ups, ultimately delaying a lot of my progress on being able to finish it off. Despite losing my original copy, I decided to fully remake this spreadsheet with the intention of making it 1000x better, which has completely sent me on a massive objective of finally being able to create.. The Renekton Bible. 

As I’m currently writing this, I have many other future plans to make this a lot bigger, including making Early, Mid and Late game tabs that will teach people everything they need to know within these stages of the game when it comes to playing Renekton. I will try my hardest to update my spreadsheet if any big changes happen through the game, while I also will use any feedback given to try and make improvements through the course of time.

I really hope all of you guys enjoy the effort I put into this, I also hope you all learn and educate yourselves on everything you want to know!

To use this spreadsheet, simply look at the bottom of the screen to see all the tabs underneath. Once looking at the tabs, simply click on whichever page you want to look at “FAQ, Runes, Summoners”, all of these will provide you everything you need to know about each topic. Once you’re on the page, make sure to scroll down the page to read or view each section to see all the details within the page. Make sure to also use CTRL F to help you find any contents within the page, E.G. "Q Cancels", "Olaf", "WMax" to find the desired content on the page. If you think I need to update or fix any details, make sure to DM me on my discord or write on my spreadsheet feedback channel.
